animation_primitives.philosophy: Inspired by reactbits.dev. All implemented in src/animations.jsx as small, composable components that respect prefers-reduced-motion via CSS in src/index.css.

components.name: SplitText
components.purpose: Letter-by-letter reveal animation, triggered on view

components.name: ShinyText
components.purpose: Animated gradient shimmer sweep over text
components.tech: CSS background-clip: text + animated background-position; shimmer-stops swap with theme via --shimmer-stops

components.name: ParticleField
components.purpose: Canvas particle network with proximity-based linkages
components.tech: <canvas>, raf loop, configurable density and HSL hue (theme-aware)

components.name: AuroraBackground
components.purpose: Conic gradient blob + radial accents + grid + grain over fixed full-viewport layer
components.tech: Pure CSS animations; reads --accent/--accent2/--accent3 vars so it retunes per theme

components.name: Marquee
components.tech: Two duplicated tracks translate from 0 to -50%; HARD CSS animation in index.css under .marquee-track class — see critical_lessons.tailwind_purge_bug

components.name: Counter
components.tech: raf-driven easeOutCubic; passes through non-numeric strings like '24/26' unchanged

components.name: CursorGlow
components.purpose: Soft gradient blob following the cursor
components.tech: framer-motion useSpring on motion values bound to mousemove; pointer-events: none

components.name: ScrollProgress
components.purpose: Top progress bar tied to page scroll
components.tech: framer-motion useScroll + useSpring on scaleX with origin-left

tailwind_purge_bug.symptom: Marquee strip didn't scroll despite the class animate-marquee being present in the markup.
tailwind_purge_bug.root_cause: Class was generated via string interpolation (`animate-${speed}`) in JSX. Tailwind only retains classes it can statically scan as literals — it tree-shook the @keyframes and animation rule from the bundle. The class made it onto the element but had no CSS behind it.
tailwind_purge_bug.fix: Replaced the dynamic class with a hard-coded `.marquee-track` class in src/index.css with its own @keyframes marquee-scroll definition. Bonus: pause on hover and respect prefers-reduced-motion.
tailwind_purge_bug.general_takeaway: Never assemble Tailwind class names via string interpolation. Either use literal class strings or add the class to the safelist in tailwind.config.js.

file_protocol_module_loading.symptom: Multi-file build (dist/) showed white screen when index.html was opened by double-click instead of via http://localhost.
file_protocol_module_loading.root_cause: <script type="module" crossorigin src="./assets/..."> is blocked by browsers under the file:// protocol due to CORS rules around ES modules.
file_protocol_module_loading.fix: Created a second build target via vite-plugin-singlefile that inlines JS, CSS, and base64 images into one HTML file. Now opens by double-click without a server.
file_protocol_module_loading.tradeoff: Single-file is ~4.5 MB vs the ~330 KB JS + separate images of the multi-file build. Multi-file build remains the right answer for real web hosting.

image_inlining_via_imports.method: To get Vite to base64-inline images, import them as ES modules: `import portraitImg from './assets/portrait.jpg'`. Combined with `assetsInlineLimit: 100_000_000` in the build config, every imported asset becomes a `data:` URL inside the bundled JS.
image_inlining_via_imports.why_string_paths_dont_work: Plain string paths like './assets/portrait.jpg' aren't seen by Vite as imports — they stay as opaque file references and don't get inlined.
image_inlining_via_imports.size_overhead: Base64 encoding adds ~33% to file size (4 ASCII chars per 3 bytes).

useinview_with_fullpage_screenshot.symptom: When taking full-page Playwright screenshots, sections below the initial viewport had empty content.
useinview_with_fullpage_screenshot.root_cause: Components used framer-motion's `useInView` with `once: true`. During `fullPage: true` capture, Playwright resizes the viewport to the entire page in one shot — IntersectionObserver never sees elements 'enter' the viewport because they're already there from the start.
useinview_with_fullpage_screenshot.fix: Switched from useInView+animate to `whileInView` with `viewport={{ once: true, amount: 0.15 }}`. whileInView reliably triggers as elements scroll into view; alternative is to scroll the page in steps before screenshotting.

lg_vs_md_breakpoint_for_desktop_mode_pho.symptom: Phone in Chrome 'Request desktop site' mode showed a stacked mobile layout with the portrait below the text and a huge dead zone.
lg_vs_md_breakpoint_for_desktop_mode_pho.root_cause: Desktop-mode Chrome on a phone reports viewport widths around 980px — just below Tailwind's lg: breakpoint of 1024px. The two-column hero grid was tied to lg:, so it fell back to the default (single-column stacked) layout.
lg_vs_md_breakpoint_for_desktop_mode_pho.fix: Moved the side-by-side layout from lg: to md: (768px). Real mobile (under 768px) still gets stacked; everything else gets the two-column layout.

fractional_grid_columns_squashing.symptom: On 1440x900 desktop, the portrait got squashed to ~140px wide because the giant 'Senthamizhan R.' typography pushed the text column wider, leaving only scraps for the portrait column.
fractional_grid_columns_squashing.root_cause: Used fractional ratios like `1.45fr | 0.55fr`. fr units distribute REMAINING space after intrinsic content, so the portrait got starved.
fractional_grid_columns_squashing.fix: Use a fixed-width portrait column instead: `md:grid-cols-[minmax(0,1fr)_18rem]`. Text takes whatever's left; portrait stays predictable across viewports.

min_h_svh_creating_dead_space.symptom: Tall narrow viewports (e.g., phone in desktop mode at 980x1800) showed huge empty space below the hero content.
min_h_svh_creating_dead_space.root_cause: Hero had `min-h-[100svh]` forcing it to be at least one viewport tall. On a 1800px tall viewport, that's lots of empty pixels when the content is shorter.
min_h_svh_creating_dead_space.fix: Removed min-h. Hero now sizes to its content (pb-20 pt-32 md:pb-28 md:pt-40). The 'scroll' cue still anchors to the section's bottom via absolute positioning.

critical_lessons.reactbits_animations_pattern: When implementing React Bits-style animations, prefer creating a small primitives module (animations.jsx) with composable, focused components. Each should respect prefers-reduced-motion. Components like SplitText, BlurReveal, TiltCard, MagnetButton, Marquee form a vocabulary that can be reused across sections.

recreation_prompt.summary: Build a polished, animated personal CV website for R. Senthamizhan, a researcher in nonlinear dynamics and mathematical physics at SASTRA University. Use Vite + React 18 + Framer Motion + Tailwind CSS. Implement React Bits–style animation primitives (SplitText, BlurReveal, TiltCard, MagnetButton, ParticleField, AuroraBackground, Marquee, Counter, CursorGlow, ScrollProgress) in a dedicated animations.jsx module. Drive all content from a single src/data.js file. Use semantic color tokens (bg, fg, accent, accent2, accent3) backed by CSS variables that swap on .dark / .light classes for a working dark/light theme toggle. Provide both a multi-file build for hosting and a single-file build that inlines images as base64 for offline distribution.
must_have_sections: CV (education + experience + award + conferences + skills + references)
must_have_decisions: Hero side-by-side layout activates at md: (768px), NOT lg: — to handle desktop-mode phones
Portrait column is fixed-width (18rem md, 22rem lg), NOT fractional — to prevent squashing
Hero section has NO min-h — sizes to content to avoid dead space
Marquee animation MUST be a hard CSS class with @keyframes in index.css — NOT a Tailwind animate-* class assembled via string interpolation
Images MUST be ES module imports for the single-file build to inline them
Theme tokens MUST flow from CSS variables so particle field, aurora, shimmer text all retune in one place
must_avoid: Any text labels or floating tags overlaid on the portrait card — clean photo only
Reproducing the previous 'Higher-order harmonics' or '2D chimeras' project cards — replaced
A duplicate award image card in the Contact section — single contact panel only
Generic AI-design aesthetics — favor restrained editorial-magazine look with Fraunces display + Manrope body
